title: Canonical finite-model evaluation isomorphism
statement: For T Noetherian, ell invertible, d,n and an ordinary isomorphism c from realization_n(finiteSheaf_n) to quotientLine_n, define the isomorphism from restriction of the finite derived twist to evaluation_n(strictDerivedTower) by finiteModelIso, exact restriction/single, single of restricted c, and the inverse exact evaluation/single comparison.

lean.statement:
def finiteEvaluationModel
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (hT : IsUnit (ell : Γ(T, ⊤))) (d n : ℕ)
    (c : (realization T ell n).obj (finiteSheaf T ell n d) ≅ quotientLine T ell n d) :
    (pbcDerivedRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) n)).obj
        ((derivedRealization T ell n).obj (finiteTwist T ell n d)) ≅
      (pbcTowerEvaluation T (pbcAdicCompletion T (datum.{u} ell)) n).obj
        (strictDerivedTower T ell d)
